senses.gloss: f. (גָדַל I) growth. דרך ג׳ the way a thing grows, in natural position.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 67a:17">Nidd. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>דרך גְּדִילָתָהּ</he> in her natural position (not pressing limbs together).
<cite ref="Sukkah 45b:2">Succ. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>דרך גְּדִילָתָן</he> as the plants grow (not upside down); a. e.
